title: Vekua-Type Operators on Compact Lie Groups: Hypoellipticity, Solvability, and Self-Duality
summary: We study global hypoellipticity and global solvability for Vekua-type operators associated with diagonal left-invariant operators on compact Lie groups. The conjugation term produces, on the Fourier side, a family of coupled systems whose determinants govern both regularity and solvability. Under a natural non-self-duality assumption, we obtain complete Diophantine-type characterizations of global hypoellipticity and global solvability, the latter on the natural space of admissible data.
